mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tl_todo_tasks (user_id, title, description, status, due_time, due_date, color_code, display_order, completed_at, meeting_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{dueTime}, #{dueDate}, #{colorCode}, #{displayOrder}, #{completedAt}, #{meetingId})
mapper.update: UPDATE tl_todo_tasks SET status = #{status}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'completed' THEN FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) * 1000) ELSE NULL END WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE tl_todo_tasks
title = #{title}, description = #{description}, due_time = #{dueTime}, due_date = #{dueDate}, color_code = #{colorCode}, display_order = #{displayOrder}, meeting_id = #{meetingId},
status = #{status}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'completed' THEN FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) * 1000) ELSE NULL END,
WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND user_id = #{userId}
